_help: YOUR STOCK LIST. Add a product by copying any block in "products" and editing it. Only "name", "category" and "price" are required. IMAGES: put files in assets/img/products/ and list the file names, e.g. "images": ["oxford-1.jpg", "oxford-2.jpg"] — first one is the card photo. CATEGORY TILES/hero artwork use the files mapped in the categories list and content/site.json → media.categoryImages / media.heroImages. VIDEO: put the file in assets/video/ and write "video": "oxford.mp4". Leave them empty to use generated artwork. SIZES: write a list, or "@shoesMen" to reuse a preset below. Set "inStock": false to show a Sold out badge. Product ids and SKUs are generated automatically.

colors._help: Swatch colours shown in the filters and on product cards. Add any new colour name you use.

facetLabels._help: Left-hand filter headings. The filter list itself is built from the products in each category.
